Chevron's total revenue fell about 7.1% from Q1 2023 to Q4 2023. I used the "Total Revenues and Other Income" line from its income statements.

- **Q1 2023:** Total revenues and other income were $50,793 million.
- **Q4 2023:** Chevron's filings give full-year and nine-month totals, so I derived the quarter by subtraction. Full-year 2023 was $200,949 million. The nine months ended September 30, 2023 were $153,769 million. That leaves $47,180 million for Q4.
- **Change:** (47,180 − 50,793) / 50,793 ≈ −7.11%.

If you meant only "Sales and other operating revenues," the answer is different. That line was $48,842 million in Q1 and about $48,933 million in Q4 (196,913 − 147,980), a rise of about 0.2%.
